options iteration=100 duration=90;

kamisatoayaka char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
kamisatoayaka add weapon="mistsplitterreforged" lvl=90/90 refine=1;
kamisatoayaka add set="blizzardstrayer" count=4;
kamisatoayaka add stats atk%=0.464 cd=0.62;

target lvl=90 resist=0.1 pos=0,1;

active kamisatoayaka;
while 1 {
    if .kamisatoayaka.burst.ready { kamisatoayaka burst; }
    if .kamisatoayaka.skill.ready { kamisatoayaka skill; }
    if .kamisatoayaka.attack.ready { kamisatoayaka attack:3; }
}
